Recent notes

  • Scintillator recovery after the γ-flash 2026-10-21N_TOFScintillators

    Quick pass: example and average waveforms of the 44 X17 scintillator channels after the n_TOF flash, and the time each one takes to come back to baseline, split by beam intensity.

  • det3 X neighbour asymmetry: a strip-registration field on the June boards 2026-10-21DetectorCrosstalk

    From the raw ADC up: every June-built board carries a smooth, two-signed X-only field of unequal ±1 neighbours (det2’s bands cancel), fixed per board and scaled by the cloud width. Excluded: code, electronics, connectors, copper, copies and offsets. Simulated resistive-strip registration gives the shape at ~1/3 of the size; wider strips and gap funnelling reach ×1.8, a leaky gap explains the June boards’ cross-strip charge but not the asymmetry. The production position carries it (K −0.77); wft.xasym corrects det2 and det3.

  • B4C target: why the July B4C night shows no pairs 2026-10-20N_TOFGeant4B4CPairs

    The B4C disc made 1.6 internal pairs per pulse, but at ≤ 11.45 MeV their leptons stop before the plastics: Geant4 expects 0.03 pair events in the whole night. Data inventory, the simulation, and the comparison with ³He.

  • Big trigger plastics: build them ourselves 2026-10-20FacilitiesDetector

    In-house plates €30k vs €82k; thick plates stay uniform; a 2.5 MeV threshold hides soft γ; split-in-two option; per-facility γ follow-up.

  • Birmingham HF-ADNeF X17 feasibility 2026-10-20BirminghamFeasibility

    Could the MX17 apparatus test the ATOMKI ⁴He anomaly at the Birmingham 30 mA ⁷Li(p,n) source? Facility, the beam port it needs, Geant4 soft-beam background and the reach.

  • FRM II MEDAPP X17 feasibility 2026-10-20Frm2MedappFeasibility
